'''Mike Merletto'''<ref name="dt-9391">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9391 Court Of The Vile Abyssins], DeckTech (Mike "OQrygg" Merletto, 12 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9391/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9391/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018135105/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9391/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''OQrygg''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]] list on DeckTech in August 2000.
